identify: The photo model matched this to a caterpillar that eats rice leaves.
The swarming caterpillar is a regional rice pest.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 1 damaged tiller/hill or 2 larvae/ m2.

cultural: Do summer ploughing. It exposes the larvae and pupae to birds and weather.
Collect the egg masses and larvae and destroy them.
biological: Protect spiders, mirid bugs and other natural enemies in the field.
